title: Nested List with Bulleted Subentries

illustrates.quote: c. Transcribe bulleted subentries as a nested list. (See Sample 8-12: Bulleted List on page 8-25, Sample 8-13: Nested List with Bulleted Subentries on page 8-26, Sample 8-14: Bulleted Nested List on page 8-27, and Sample 8-15: Two Distinct Bullets in a Simple List on page 8-28.)

blocks.features: Two numbered main items; item 2 has three checkmark-bulleted subentries.

items.text: Pay attention to the following features:
the style of the letters used in headings
the way the information is organized into columns

print.printFeatures: Boxed list; main items numbered '1.'/'2.'; three checkmark-bulleted subentries indented under item 2.

braille.notes: A top box rule (line 8, 40 '7's) and a transcriber's note (lines 9-10, identifying the checkmark symbol) precede the list itself (lines 12-19; the box's own top matter/heading lies outside the requested excerpt). Main entries '#a4'/'#b4' (1./2.) begin cell 1; the three checkmark-bulleted subentries (bullet '"%', the 'Checkmark' symbol from 8.6.2.a) begin cell 3 as a nested list, per 8.6.2.c, with one runover (the third check-item wraps from line 16 to line 17, indented to cell 5); a bottom box rule (line 18, 40 'g's) and a blank line (19) close the box.

resolution: braille.lines byte-identical between A and B. The braille-only transcriber’s note explaining the checkmark symbol (lines 3-4 of the excerpt) has no print-side counterpart at all (B’s own account confirms this) — left out of print.blocks entirely (there is nothing in print to model), recorded as a limitation instead of forced into a block kind that would misrepresent it; this is F-33 item 3’s documented gap (no transcriber-defined-symbol/Special Symbols mechanism). Because that note and the surrounding box rules can’t be built, this file is NOT wrapped in a `box` print block (unlike sample-8-04, which has no such gap) — the list alone is modeled, with the note/box limitation recorded; a mismatch against the box-rule lines is expected and documented, not "fixed". Checkmark subentries (marker "√", not Emboss’s one supported bullet •) are recorded as-is; buildModel8 records the missing correspondence per F-33 rather than guessing one.
